newsitem.title: USA: DI Industries signs for new credit line.
newsitem.headline: DI Industries signs for new credit line.

text.p: DI Industries Inc said on Wednesday it obtained a commitment from Bankers Trust Co and ING (U.S.) Capital Corp to provide a $35 million reducing revolving credit facility.
The company said it would use the facility to fund the previously announced acquisition of Diamond M Onshore Inc's operating assets for $26 million, and for other general corporate purposes.
The facility would provide for an initial loan commitment of $35 million, which would be reduced each year by $5 million until the December 31, 1999 maturity date, the company said.
